## The data

Edit data/*.yaml; generated files are rebuilt by scripts/build.py. Add an i18n/*.yaml file with the same keys to introduce a language; missing entry translations fall back to English.

## Local development

```sh
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
python scripts/validate.py
python scripts/build.py
python scripts/build.py --check
python scripts/check_links.py --dry-run
python -m unittest discover -s tests
python -m http.server 8000 --directory site
```

## For featured authors

Maintainers may award this badge after a documented featured review. It is not awarded to any seed entry.
